query:
UPDATE delivery_matching_queue
            SET
                status = $2,
                next_attempt_at = COALESCE($3, next_attempt_at),
                payload = COALESCE($4, payload),
                attempt_count = attempt_count + CASE WHEN $5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE delivery_id = $1
